name: Active/Shutter 3D TV
description: Active shutter 3D TVs that display full resolution per eye using synchronized LCD shutter glasses. Support frame-sequential (DLP Link, i-Sight) and HDMI frame packing.
notes: Active 3D TVs provide full resolution in each eye and deliver significantly better quality than passive. Require DLP Link / i-Sight emulation or frame-packing support via HDMI or DP.

sbs.notes: Side-by-side output converted to frame-sequential by WibbleWobbleVR or DLP Link emulator.

tab.notes: Top-and-bottom output converted to frame-sequential by WibbleWobbleVR.

frame_packing.notes: HDMI frame-packed output at 1920x2205. Custom resolution must be configured in Nvidia Control Panel first.

sbs.notes: WibbleWobbleVR renders frame-sequential from SBS source for 3D Vision and DLP Link displays.

frame_packing.notes: Frame-packed 1920x2205 or 1280x1470 output. Configure custom resolution in Nvidia Control Panel.

frame_sequential.notes: Native frame-sequential output from game or ReShade. Primary output type for this display.

vrto3d.notes: VRto3D can render frame-packed content. See setup_notes for custom resolution requirements.

headtracking.notes: Active 3D TVs do not support head tracking. Intended for seated/fixed-view play.

setup_notes: For frame-sequential (DLP Link / i-Sight): Use WibbleWobbleVR with VRto3D profiles. Set launch_script in VRto3D to start the frame-sequential mode.
For frame-packing 1920x2205 @ 60Hz: Create custom resolution in Nvidia Control Panel with horizontal 1920-2750, vertical 2205 pixels.
For frame-packing 1280x1470 @ 60Hz: Create custom resolution with horizontal 1280-1650, vertical 1470 pixels.
Set display_index in VRto3D default_config.json to target the 3D TV display.
Enable 3DToElse in ReShade if using anaglyph or interlaced modes.
